knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation. An apartment at 182.900 € shares the page with a 1,99 € line item — five orders of magnitude. German conventions are read correctly in both directions (dot grouping in 182.900 €, comma decimal in 1,99 €), and the property prices themselves are internally consistent at "###.# ZEC". The break is 1,99 € at 0.002781 ZEC and 114 € at 0.16 ZEC against 255.6 ZEC, which no single decimal count reconciles.
